description: This file defines the AttendanceHelper class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for migration purposes in version 5.0.0. It provides methods for updating timezone offsets in the attendance records database table, including a timezone map and database query methods.

classes.name: AttendanceHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing timezone offset updates in attendance records during migration in OrangeHRM version 5.0.0.

methods.name: updatePunchInTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Updates the punch-in timezone name in the attendance record based on the given offset and timezone.

methods.name: updatePunchOutTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Updates the punch-out timezone name in the attendance record based on the given offset and timezone.
